item.text:
Implemented an opt-in monitoring decorator for search strategies.

Added:

- [SearchObserver.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/001_binary_search/SearchObserver.java): observer contract for start, completion, and failure events.
- [SearchExecutionMetrics.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/001_binary_search/SearchExecutionMetrics.java): captures strategy name, item count, result, and elapsed nanoseconds.
- [MonitoringSearchStrategy.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/001_binary_search/MonitoringSearchStrategy.java): decorator wrapping any `SearchStrategy<T>`.
- [NoOpSearchObserver.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/001_binary_search/NoOpSearchObserver.java): silent observer for tests or disabled monitoring.
- [ConsoleSearchObserver.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/001_binary_search/ConsoleSearchObserver.java): simple stderr logging observer.

Updated [SearchStrategies.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/001_binary_search/SearchStrategies.java) with factory helpers like:

```java
SearchStrategies.monitoredRecursiveBinarySearch(new ConsoleSearchObserver())
SearchStrategies.monitoredIterativeBinarySearch(new NoOpSearchObserver())
```
